rationale: Causally plausible and implementable on manufacturing equipment but key evidence gaps remain (validated spike‑in/capture‑compatibility controls, quantitative TFF parameter thresholds, reproducible >=3‑lot scale‑proxy runs, and short‑interval in vivo bridging). Proceed to a matrixed TFF parameter study with prevalidated spike‑in/capture controls and predefined quantitative acceptance criteria before any product decisions.
